description.zh: 键集分页 token，获取第一页数据时无需传入，否则需要传入前一页查询结果中的 nextToken 字段
description.en: The pagination token for keyset pagination. To retrieve the next page of results, pass the `nextToken` value from the previous response. Omit this parameter to retrieve the first page.

description.zh: 分页排序属性，决定根据何种属性进行记录排序；默认 gmtCreate
description.en: The property to sort the results by. Default: `gmtCreate`.

description.zh: 键集分页模式下不需要传入
description.en: The page number to retrieve. This parameter is used for page number-based pagination and is ignored if `pagination` is set to `keyset`.

description.zh: 分页模式参数：keyset表示键集分页
description.en: The pagination mode. Set this to `keyset` to use keyset pagination.

description.zh: 分页尺寸参数，决定一页最多返回多少对象，默认20，限制[1,100]
description.en: The number of items to return per page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 100. Default: 20.
The serial number (SN) of the release stage.
The serial number (SN) of the release workflow.

description.zh: 分页排序升降序，asc 为升序，desc 为降序；默认 desc
description.en: The sort order. Use `asc` for ascending order and `desc` for descending order. Default: `desc`.

title.zh: 批量查询研发阶段执行记录
title.en: Batch query execution records of development stages
